1.original_instruction: In Manuk , go into the last room in the horseshoe-shaped building (manuk 309, 322) and talk to the Manuk Engineer. They ask you to collect 20 Bradium Fragments (Dropped by Bradium Golems ).
1.short_ru: Получите у Manuk Engineer в manuk 309, 322 просьбу собрать 20 Bradium Fragments.
1.short_en: Get the request for 20 Bradium Fragments from Manuk Engineer at manuk 309, 322.
1.full_ru: В Manuk войдите в последнюю комнату подковообразного здания (manuk 309, 322) и поговорите с Manuk Engineer. Вас попросят собрать 20 Bradium Fragments, выпадающих из Bradium Golems.
1.full_en: In Manuk , go into the last room in the horseshoe-shaped building (manuk 309, 322) and talk to the Manuk Engineer. They ask you to collect 20 Bradium Fragments (Dropped by Bradium Golems ).
